name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_append_time_status302a
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::AppendTimeStatus302A formats and appends localized WOL time status 0x302a using CRT ctime.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Modern UCRT time_t may be wider than the retail x86 CRT time_t; the source keeps the callback ABI value as long and converts to local time_t for provider compatibility.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x441260 validates the three-argument stdcall callback contract, append only when status is zero, 128-byte stack buffer, CRT ctime call using the unix time argument, zLoc::FormatMessage(buffer, 128, 0x302a, ctimeText), WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::AppendStatusTextFmt, and return value 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_append_time_status302a_smoke patches FormatMessage and AppendStatusTextFmt and verifies the nonzero-status no-op, message id 0x302a, buffer size, ctime text handoff, append receiver, appended formatted text, and return value.
